name: Jeeves Server
description: File browsing, document sharing, export, and event gateway tools for jeeves-server.

pluginKey.description: Server _plugin key seed (for authenticated API calls)

configRoot.description: Platform config root directory (e.g. j:/config). Core derives component config dirs from this path.

publicUrl.description: Public base URL for shareable links (e.g. https://jeeves.johngalt.id). When set, all URLs returned to tool callers are rewritten to use this host. When absent, URLs use the apiUrl (development behavior).

pluginKey.label: Plugin Key Seed
pluginKey.placeholder: hex string from server config keys._plugin
